# neptune

Amazon Neptune Database and Neptune Analytics - Gremlin/openCypher/SPARQL access, explain/profile plans (non-native steps, unbounded estimates, all-label scans), Analytics algorithms and vector topK, plus cluster encryption posture from dumps.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-013` | medium | Graph traversal/query without a limit |
| `AF-STORE-004` | critical | Neptune cluster storage is not encrypted |
| `AF-GDB-007` | medium | SPARQL property path with + or * and no bound |
| `AF-GDB-009` | medium | Neptune Analytics algorithm with no scoping MATCH |
| `AF-GDB-010` | medium | Neptune Analytics vector search without topK |
| `AF-GDB-020` | medium | Plan falls back to non-native TinkerPop steps |
| `AF-GDB-021` | medium | Plan carries an unbounded cardinality estimate |
| `AF-GDB-022` | low | Plan warns about the number of predicates |
| `AF-GDB-023` | medium | Plan scans all labels |
